sloka: एतेन साह्यम् सुमहत् कृतम् शक्रस्य धीमता ।देव असुरे जाम्बवता लब्धाः च बहवो वराः ॥६-२७-१२॥।।
transliteration: etena sāhyam sumahat kṛtam śakrasya dhīmatā ।deva asure jāmbavatā labdhāḥ ca bahavo varāḥ ॥6-27-12॥।।

translations.english: "His assistance was given to Indra in the war between Devas and demons and in turn he obtained many boons."
